hooks.command: sh -c 'R=415aeb96ae731e81c9f40f761be584d18d063c34; B="$(command -v playpilot || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/playpilot")"; D="$(dirname "$(dirname "$B")")"; if [ "$(cat "$D/share/playpilot.rev" 2>/dev/null)" != "$R" ]; then for c in cargo /root/.cargo/bin/cargo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo"; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$c" install --force --locked --quiet --git https://github.com/modootoday/playpilot --rev "$R" --root "$D" playpilot >&2 && mkdir -p "$D/share" && echo "$R" > "$D/share/playpilot.rev" && break; done; fi; [ -x "$B" ] || { echo "playpilot CLI is missing and could not be installed" >&2; exit 2; }; PLAYPILOT_PROTECTED_BRANCHES=main,codex/rust exec "$B" guard'
